title: Confirm button is red to deactivate and blue to activate
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part, active; [Part-B] = tracked part, set inactive. Numbers share the start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTNCOL-0.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BTNCOL A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTNCOL-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTNCOL-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BTNCOL A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BTNCOL B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTNCOL-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BTNCOL-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BTNCOL B).
  5. Set [Part-B] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-B], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  6. Check the setup worked: [Part-A] on the Active tab, [Part-B] on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Open [Part-A], pick "Inactive", click Save and look at the confirmation's buttons; click "Cancel" and close the dialog.
  2. Open [Part-B] on the Inactive tab, pick "Active", click Save and look at the buttons; click "Cancel" and close the dialog.
  3. On the Active tab turn on "Deactivate parts", tick [Part-A], click "Deactivate" and look at the buttons; click "Cancel" and × on the bar.
  4. On the Inactive tab turn on "Activate parts", tick [Part-B], click "Activate" and look at the buttons; click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: A red "Deactivate" button, with "Cancel" to its left.
  • Step 2: A blue "Activate" button, with "Cancel" to its left.
  • Step 3: A red "Deactivate" button, with "Cancel" to its left.
  • Step 4: A blue "Activate" button, with "Cancel" to its left. No part changed status.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S10-R11, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 3.3, 3.7, 4.4 and 4.7. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
